3. The seat number isn't 22B.

4. The passenger didn't check in three heavy boxes.

5. The flight doesn't leave from Gate 12A.

6. Boarding doesn't start at noon.

7. The backpack cannot be left in the middle of the aisle.

8. The passenger didn't ask for a cup of hot coffee.

Airport & Flights

Pronunciation Practice

1. Good morning! Can I have your passport and ticket, please?
2. Good morning. Here you go.
3. Can I get a window seat?
4. Sure, let me check. Yes, window seat 14A is open.
5. Do you have any bags to check in today?
6. Just this big suitcase.
7. Can I take this backpack with me on the plane?
8. Yes, you can take it with you.
9. Here is your boarding pass. Gate 4B.
10. Boarding starts at 10:30.
11. Thank you very much! Have a great day.
12. Excuse me, where can I put my backpack?
13. You can put it under the seat in front of you.
14. Or get some space in the overhead bin.
15. Perfect, thank you.
16. And can I have a glass of water, please?
17. Of course! Here you go. Enjoy your flight.
18. Thanks a lot!
